crossRefs.note: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

parallels.note: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
translations.asv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and tell John the things which ye hear and see:
